title: Statement of ICC Prosecutor Karim A.A. Khan KC: Applications for Arrest Warrants in the Situation in the State of Palestine
authors: Office of the Prosecutor, International Criminal Court
summary: Formal applications submitted to ICC Pre-Trial Chamber I for arrest warrants against Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Defense Minister Yoav Gallant for war crimes and crimes against humanity, specifically including starvation of civilians as a method of warfare, willfully causing great suffering, and intentional attacks against a civilian population.
